verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: De novo, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: מַה־ לָּכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֙ מֹֽשְׁלִים֙ אֶת־ הַמָּשָׁ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אָבוֹת֙ יֹ֣אכְלוּ בֹ֔סֶר וְשִׁנֵּ֥י הַבָּנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: mah- lā·ḵem ’at·tem mō·šə·lîm ’eṯ- ham·mā·šāl haz·zeh ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’ā·ḇō·wṯ yō·ḵə·lū ḇō·ser wə·šin·nê hab·bā·nîm tiq·he·nāh
verses.literal: What do you people mean by quoting this proverb - about the land of Israel . . . The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the teeth of the children are set on edge
verses.literalPt: Que quereis vós dizer, usando na terra de Israel deste provérbio: Os pais comeram uvas verdes, e os dentes dos filhos estão embotados?

verses.original: חַי־ אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אִם־ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם ע֗וֹד מְשֹׁ֛ל הַמָּשָׁ֥ל הַזֶּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- yih·yeh lā·ḵem ‘ō·wḏ mə·šōl ham·mā·šāl haz·zeh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD you will no . . . longer quote this proverb in Israel
verses.literalPt: Pela minha vida, diz o Senhor Jeová, não tereis mais ocasião de usardes desse provérbio em Israel.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל־ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣י הֵ֔נָּה כְּנֶ֧פֶשׁ הָאָ֛ב וּכְנֶ֥פֶשׁ הַבֵּ֖ן לִי־ הֵ֑נָּה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: hên kāl- han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lî hên·nāh kə·ne·p̄eš hā·’āḇ ū·ḵə·ne·p̄eš hab·bên lî- hên·nāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·ḥō·ṭêṯ hî ṯā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Behold every soul belongs to Me both father and son are Mine The soul who sins is the one who will die
verses.literalPt: Eis que todas as almas são minhas; como o é a alma do pai, assim também a alma do filho é minha; a alma que pecar, essa morrerá.

verses.original: וְאִ֖ישׁ כִּי־ יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yih·yeh ṣad·dîq wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Now suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right
verses.literalPt: Porém, se um homem for justo, e fizer o que é de equidade e justiça,

verses.original: אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־ אֵ֤שֶׁת רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א וְאֶל־ אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- he·hā·rîm lō ’ā·ḵāl wə·‘ê·nāw lō nā·śā ’el- gil·lū·lê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū lō ṭim·mê wə·’el- ’iš·šāh nid·dāh lō yiq·rāḇ
verses.literal: He does not eat at the mountain or look . . . to the idols of the house of Israel He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her period
verses.literalPt: e se não comer sobre os montes, nem levantar os seus olhos para os ídolos da casa de Israel, nem contaminar a mulher do seu próximo, nem se chegar à mulher na sua separação;

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה חֲבֹלָת֥וֹ חוֹב֙ יָשִׁ֔יב גְּזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב יִתֵּ֔ן וְעֵירֹ֖ם יְכַסֶּה־ בָּֽגֶד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš lō yō·w·neh ḥă·ḇō·lā·ṯōw ḥō·wḇ yā·šîḇ gə·zê·lāh lō yiḡ·zōl laḥ·mōw lə·rā·‘êḇ yit·tên wə·‘ê·rōm yə·ḵas·seh- bā·ḡeḏ
verses.literal: He does not oppress another but restores the pledge to the debtor He does not commit robbery but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing
verses.literalPt: se não oprimir a ninguém, porém tornar ao devedor o seu penhor, se não tirar nada do alheio por violência, se der do seu pão ao que tem fome e ao nu cobrir com vestido;

verses.original: בַּנֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־ יִתֵּ֗ן וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח מֵעָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יָד֑וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ban·ne·šeḵ lō- yit·tên wə·ṯar·bîṯ lō yiq·qāḥ mê·‘ā·wel yā·šîḇ yā·ḏōw miš·paṭ ’ĕ·meṯ ya·‘ă·śeh bên ’îš lə·’îš
verses.literal: He does not engage in usury or take excess interest but he withholds his hand from iniquity . . . and executes true justice between men . . .
verses.literalPt: se não der o seu dinheiro à usura, nem receber mais do que o que emprestou, se desviar a sua mão da iniquidade e fizer verdadeiro juízo entre homem e homem;

verses.original: בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֧י יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שָׁמַ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֱמֶ֑ת צַדִּ֥יק הוּא֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay yə·hal·lêḵ ū·miš·pā·ṭay šā·mar la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ĕ·meṯ ṣad·dîq hū ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: He follows My statutes and faithfully keeps . . . My ordinances That man is righteous surely he will live . . . declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: se andar nos meus estatutos e guardar os meus juízos, para proceder segundo a verdade, este tal é justo; certamente, viverá, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְהוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן־ פָּרִ֖יץ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְעָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵאַחַ֖ד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·lîḏ bên- pā·rîṣ šō·p̄êḵ dām wə·‘ā·śāh ’āḥ mê·’a·ḥaḏ mê·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Now suppose that man has a violent son who sheds blood or does . . . any of these things
verses.literalPt: Se ele gerar um filho que se torne salteador, que derrame sangue, e que faça a seu irmão qualquer dessas coisas,

verses.original: וְה֕וּא אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָכַ֔ל וְאֶת־ אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh lō ‘ā·śāh kî ḡam ’el- he·hā·rîm ’ā·ḵal wə·’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū ṭim·mê
verses.literal: though the father has done . . . none . . . of them Indeed the son eats at the mountain and defiles his neighbor’s wife
verses.literalPt: e que não cumpra com nenhum destes deveres, porém coma sobre os montes, e contamine a mulher do seu próximo,

verses.original: עָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנָ֔ה גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל חֲבֹ֖ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב וְאֶל־ הַגִּלּוּלִים֙ נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔יו תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn hō·w·nāh gə·zê·lō·wṯ gā·zāl ḥă·ḇōl lō yā·šîḇ wə·’el- hag·gil·lū·lîm nā·śā ‘ê·nāw tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: He oppresses the poor and needy he commits robbery . . . and does not restore a pledge He lifts his eyes to idols he commits abominations
verses.literalPt: oprima ao pobre e necessitado, tire de outro com violência, não devolva o penhor, levante os seus olhos aos ídolos, cometa abominações,

verses.original: בַּנֶּ֧שֶׁךְ נָתַ֛ן וְתַרְבִּ֥ית לָקַ֖ח וָחָ֑י לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵב֤וֹת הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת דָּמָ֖יו בּ֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ban·ne·šeḵ nā·ṯan wə·ṯar·bîṯ lā·qaḥ wā·ḥāy lō yiḥ·yeh ’êṯ kāl- hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ‘ā·śāh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ dā·māw bōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: He engages in usury and takes excess interest Will this son live He will not . . . Since he has committed all these abominations he will surely die . . . his blood will be on his own head
verses.literalPt: dê o seu dinheiro à usura e receba mais do que emprestou, acaso, viverá ele? Não viverá. Comete todas essas abominações; certamente, morrerá, e o seu sangue será sobre ele.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וַיַּ֕רְא אֶת־ כָּל־ חַטֹּ֥את אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּרְאֶ֕ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כָּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh hō·w·lîḏ bên way·yar ’eṯ- kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ ’ā·ḇîw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yir·’eh wə·lō ya·‘ă·śeh kā·hên
verses.literal: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed considers them and does not do likewise . . .
verses.literalPt: Eis que se este, por sua vez, gerar um filho que, vendo todos os pecados cometidos por seu pai, tema e não faça coisas semelhantes,

verses.original: עַל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־ אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ לֹ֥א טִמֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- he·hā·rîm lō ’ā·ḵāl wə·‘ê·nāw lō nā·śā ’el- gil·lū·lê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū lō ṭim·mê
verses.literal: He does not eat at the mountain or look . . . to the idols of the house of Israel He does not defile his neighbor’s wife
verses.literalPt: que não coma sobre os montes, nem levante os seus olhos aos ídolos da casa de Israel, que não contamine a mulher do seu próximo,

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א הוֹנָ֔ה חֲבֹל֙ לֹ֣א חָבָ֔ל וּגְזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א גָזָ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב נָתָ֔ן וְעֵר֖וֹם כִּסָּה־ בָֽגֶד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš lō hō·w·nāh ḥă·ḇōl lō ḥā·ḇāl ū·ḡə·zê·lāh lō ḡā·zāl laḥ·mōw lə·rā·‘êḇ nā·ṯān wə·‘ê·rō·wm kis·sāh- ḇā·ḡeḏ
verses.literal: He does not oppress another or retain a pledge . . . or commit robbery . . . He gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing
verses.literalPt: nem oprima a pessoa alguma, que não empreste sob penhores, nem tire de outrem com violência, porém dê o seu pão ao faminto, e ao nu cubra com vestido,

verses.original: מֵעָנִ֞י הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א לָקָ֔ח מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י עָשָׂ֔ה בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י הָלָ֑ךְ ה֗וּא לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת בַּעֲוֺ֥ן אָבִ֖יו חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ā·nî hê·šîḇ yā·ḏōw ne·šeḵ wə·ṯar·bîṯ lō lā·qāḥ miš·pā·ṭay ‘ā·śāh bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay hā·lāḵ hū lō yā·mūṯ ba·‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇîw ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: He withholds his hand from harming the poor and takes no interest or usury He keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity He will surely live . . .
verses.literalPt: que aparte do pobre a sua mão, que não receba usura nem mais do que emprestou, que execute os meus juízos e ande nos meus estatutos, este não morrerá por causa da iniquidade de seu pai; certamente, viverá.

verses.original: אָבִ֞יו כִּֽי־ עָ֣שַׁק עֹ֗שֶׁק גָּזַל֙ גֵּ֣זֶל אָ֔ח וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ ט֛וֹב עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמָּ֑יו וְהִנֵּה־ מֵ֖ת בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇîw kî- ‘ā·šaq ‘ō·šeq gā·zal gê·zel ’āḥ wa·’ă·šer lō- ṭō·wḇ ‘ā·śāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·māw wə·hin·nêh- mêṯ ba·‘ă·wō·nōw
verses.literal: As for his father he will die for his own iniquity because he practiced extortion robbed . . . his brother and did what was wrong . . . among his people . . .
verses.literalPt: Quanto a seu pai, porque oprimiu cruelmente, tirou de seu irmão com violência e fez o que não é bom entre o seu povo, eis que ele morrerá na sua iniquidade.

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַדֻּ֛עַ לֹא־ נָשָׂ֥א הַבֵּ֖ן בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֑ב וְהַבֵּ֞ן מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ חֻקּוֹתַ֥י שָׁמַ֛ר וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem mad·du·a‘ lō- nā·śā hab·bên ba·‘ă·wōn hā·’āḇ wə·hab·bên miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ kāl- ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay šā·mar way·ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: Yet you may ask Why shouldn’t the son . . . bear the iniquity of his father Since the son has done what is just and right carefully observing all My statutes he will surely live . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, dizeis: Por que não leva o filho a iniquidade do pai? Quando o filho fizer o que é de equidade e justiça, e guardar todos os meus estatutos, e os cumprir, certamente, viverá.

verses.original: הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֣א׀ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת רָשָׁע עָלָ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: han·ne·p̄eš ha·ḥō·ṭêṯ hî ṯā·mūṯ bên lō- yiś·śā ba·‘ă·wōn hā·’āḇ wə·’āḇ lō yiś·śā ba·‘ă·wōn hab·bên ṣiḏ·qaṯ haṣ·ṣad·dîq ‘ā·lāw tih·yeh wə·riš·‘aṯ rå̄·šå̄ʿ ‘ā·lāw tih·yeh
verses.literal: The soul who sins is the one who will die A son will not bear the iniquity of his father and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him
verses.literalPt: A alma que peca, essa morrerá; o filho não levará a iniquidade do pai, nem o pai levará a iniquidade do filho. A justiça do justo será sobre ele, e a impiedade do ímpio será sobre ele.

verses.original: וְהָרָשָׁ֗ע כִּ֤י יָשׁוּב֙ מִכָּל־ חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rā·šā‘ kî yā·šūḇ mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·šā·mar ’eṯ- kāl- ḥu·qō·w·ṯay wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed keeps all My statutes and does what is just and right he will surely live . . . he will not die
verses.literalPt: Mas, se o ímpio se converter de todos os seus pecados que cometeu, e guardar todos os meus estatutos, e fizer o que é de equidade e justiça, certamente, viverá; não morrerá.

verses.original: כָּל־ פְּשָׁעָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ל֑וֹ בְּצִדְקָת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- pə·šā·‘āw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lō yiz·zā·ḵə·rū lōw bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: None . . . of the transgressions he has committed will be held against him Because of the righteousness he has practiced he will live
verses.literalPt: Nenhuma das suas transgressões que cometeu será lembrada contra ele; na sua justiça que praticou, viverá.

verses.original: הֶחָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא בְּשׁוּב֥וֹ מִדְּרָכָ֖יו וְחָיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: he·ḥā·p̄ōṣ ’eḥ·pōṣ mō·wṯ rā·šā‘ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hă·lō·w bə·šū·ḇōw mid·də·rā·ḵāw wə·ḥā·yāh
verses.literal: Do I take any pleasure in . . . the death of the wicked declares the Lord GOD Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live
verses.literalPt: Acaso, tenho eu prazer na morte do ímpio? — diz o Senhor Jeová; não quero eu, antes, que se converta do seu caminho e viva?

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִצִּדְקָתוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל כְּכֹ֨ל הַתּוֹעֵב֜וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֧ה הָרָשָׁ֛ע יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה וָחָ֑י כָּל־ צִדְקָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂה֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה בְּמַעֲל֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ מָעַ֛ל וּבְחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ חָטָ֖א בָּ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·šūḇ ṣad·dîq miṣ·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel kə·ḵōl hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh hā·rā·šā‘ ya·‘ă·śeh wā·ḥāy kāl- ṣiḏ·qå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh lō ṯiz·zā·ḵar·nāh bə·ma·‘ă·lōw ’ă·šer- mā·‘al ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ḥā·ṭā bām yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity committing the same abominations as the wicked . . . will he live . . . None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered Because of the unfaithfulness - and sin he has committed he will die
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando o justo se desviar da sua justiça, e cometer iniquidade, e fizer conforme todas as abominações que faz o ímpio, acaso, viverá ele? Não será lembrado nenhum dos seus atos de justiça que praticou; na sua transgressão com que transgrediu e no seu pecado com que pecou, neles morrerá.

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲדַרְכִּי֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem lō yit·tā·ḵên de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy šim·‘ū- nā bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·ḏar·kî lō yit·tā·ḵên hă·lō ḏar·ḵê·ḵem lō yit·tā·ḵê·nū
verses.literal: Yet you say The way of the Lord is not just Hear now O house of Israel Is it My way that is unjust . . . Is it not your ways that are unjust . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, dizeis: O caminho do Senhor não é igual. Ouvi, pois, ó casa de Israel: Acaso, não é igual o meu caminho? Não são desiguais os vossos caminhos?

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־ צַדִּ֧יק מִצִּדְקָת֛וֹ וְעָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּמֵ֣ת עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם בְּעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·šūḇ- ṣad·dîq miṣ·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel ū·mêṯ ‘ă·lê·hem bə·‘aw·lōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity he will die for this He will die because of the iniquity he has committed
verses.literalPt: Quando o justo se desviar da sua justiça, e cometer a iniquidade, e nela morrer, na sua iniquidade que cometeu morrerá.

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֥וֹ יְחַיֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·šūḇ rā·šā‘ mê·riš·‘ā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·ya·‘aś miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh hū ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw yə·ḥay·yeh
verses.literal: But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right he will save his life
verses.literalPt: Outrossim, quando o ímpio se desviar da sua impiedade que cometeu e fizer o que é de equidade e justiça, conservará este a sua alma em vida.

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣ה וַיָּשׁוֹב מִכָּל־ פְּשָׁעָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה חָי֥וֹ יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’eh way·yå̄·šōḇ mik·kāl pə·šā·‘āw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ḥā·yōw yiḥ·yeh lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed he will surely live . . . he will not die
verses.literalPt: Porquanto considera e se desvia de todas as suas transgressões que cometeu, certamente, viverá; não morrerá.

verses.original: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י הַדְּרָכַ֞י לֹ֤א יִתָּֽכְנּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō yit·tā·ḵên de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy had·də·rā·ḵay lō yit·tå̄·ḵən·nū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·lō ḏar·ḵê·ḵem lō yit·tā·ḵên
verses.literal: Yet the house of Israel says The way of the Lord is not just Are My ways unjust O house of Israel Is it not your ways that are unjust . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, diz a casa de Israel: O caminho do Senhor não é igual. Acaso, não são iguais os meus caminhos, ó casa de Israel?

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֜יו אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְכֶם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ מִכָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם לְמִכְשׁ֖וֹל עָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’îš kiḏ·rā·ḵāw ’eš·pōṭ ’eṯ·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šū·ḇū wə·hā·šî·ḇū mik·kāl piš·‘ê·ḵem wə·lō- yih·yeh lā·ḵem lə·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: Therefore O house of Israel I will judge you each according to his ways declares the Lord GOD Repent and turn from all your transgressions so that your iniquity will not become your downfall
verses.literalPt: Portanto, vos julgarei, ó casa de Israel, cada um conforme os seus caminhos, diz o Senhor Jeová. Convertei-vos e desviai-vos de todas as vossas transgressões; assim, a iniquidade não vos será pedra de tropeço.

verses.original: הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לֵ֥ב חָדָ֖שׁ וְר֣וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלָ֥מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haš·lî·ḵū mê·‘ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- piš·‘ê·ḵem ’ă·šer pə·ša‘·tem bām wa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem lêḇ ḥā·ḏāš wə·rū·aḥ ḥă·ḏā·šāh wə·lām·māh ṯā·mu·ṯū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit Why should you die O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Lançai de vós todas as vossas transgressões com que transgredistes e fazei-vos um coração novo e um espírito novo. Pois por que morrereis, ó casa de Israel?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הַמֵּ֔ת נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָשִׁ֖יבוּ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî lō ’eḥ·pōṣ bə·mō·wṯ ham·mêṯ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hā·šî·ḇū wiḥ·yū
verses.literal: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death . . . declares the Lord GOD So repent and live
verses.literalPt: Porquanto não tenho prazer na morte do que morre, diz o Senhor Jeová. Portanto, convertei-vos e vivei.
